text:
Kiren: Thinking aloud — can we stop treating page vs ticket as binary and use a notify_score that mixes severity, confidence, and region impact?
Sam: yes. sounds cleaner. route low-confidence -> ticket, high -> page.
Marta: EU clusters noisy at night because backups. Would scoring help reduce pages there?
Lina: you can compute impact as nodes_impacted/total_nodes * avg_gpu_util and multiply by anomaly_confidence from the detector.
Kiren: prom sketch:
```promql
# anomaly_confidence from ml-detector
impact = sum(gpu_running{job="kube"}) by (region) / sum(nodes{job="kube"}) by (region)
score = impact * anomaly_confidence
```
Routing idea:
- score >= 0.85 -> page immediate
- 0.6 <= score < 0.85 -> ticket + slack notify
- score < 0.6 -> ticket only
Sam: add sustained window (3m) and per-region mute windows. if cardinality > 500 escalate differently.
Marta: autoscaler churn causes a lot of noise. can we add a "scaler_active" veto to raise page threshold during scale events?
Lina: yep. add: if scaler_active{region="eu"} == 1 then page_threshold *= 1.5
alerts-bot: deploy v0.3 to staging clusters (eu1, us-west-2-staging)
Ops-oncall: i'll run a 10-day canary in low-risk prod regions and capture pages/week and false positives.
Kiren: rollout plan: 1) staging 2) canary 10d 3) evaluate FP rate and MTTR 4) full rollout with rollback tag
Sam: i'll add a small grafana panel with weekly pages, tickets, median confidence to compare before/after: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/alerts/notify-score
Security: tagging us for audit retention change (+90 days) and an event log of notify decisions.
Lina: opening PR with rules, grafana panels, and runbook changes. assigning reviewers: @Sam @Marta @Ops-oncall
